words.gloss: to the place where he is

literal: Mind resembling, to the place where he is, if able to go, flood water, swim-not-they alas, my eyes.
translation: If my eyes could travel to where my lover is, just as my mind does, they would not be swimming in this flood of tears.
modern: என் மனத்தைப் போல என் கண்களும் அவர் உள்ள இடத்திற்குச் செல்ல முடியுமானால், அவை இப்படி வெள்ளம் போன்ற கண்ணீரில் நீந்திக் கொண்டிருக்க மாட்டா.
explanation: The heroine laments her physical separation from her lover while her mind is already with him. She wishes her eyes had the same ability as her mind to instantly travel to where he is. If they could, they would be looking at him instead of swimming in a flood of tears. The contrast between the swift, unbound mind and the physically bound, weeping eyes highlights her deep sorrow.
